name: obsidian-bigao
description: Two drafts, side by side. Native split and full-document diff for Obsidian.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test:source: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/data/block_pairing.node.test.mjs src/data/file_differences.node.test.mjs src/data/inline_decoration_ranges.node.test.mjs src/data/panel_differences.node.test.mjs src/utils/string_utils.node.test.mjs src/utils/word_diff.node.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:bundle && npm run test:source
scripts.verify: npm run audit:deps && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:source-bundle

author: SigiL
